title: Eyes Without A Face
lyrics:
[00:22.56]I'm all out of hope
[00:26.71]One more bad break
[00:29.90]Could bring a fall
[00:33.80]When I'm far from home
[00:37.68]Don't call me on the phone
[00:40.56]To tell me you're alone
[00:44.73]It's easy to deceive
[00:48.86]It's easy to tease
[00:51.72]But hard to get release
[00:56.12](Les yeux sans visage) Eyes without a face
[01:01.77](Les yeux sans visage) Eyes without a face
[01:07.42](Les yeux sans visage) Eyes without a face
[01:14.53]Got no human grace
[01:16.92]Your eyes without a face
[01:29.87]I spend so much time
[01:33.71]Believing all the lies
[01:36.77]To keep the dream alive
[01:41.07]Now it makes me sad
[01:45.02]It makes me mad at truth
[01:47.82]For loving what was you
[01:52.34](Les yeux sans visage) Eyes without a face
[01:57.97](Les yeux sans visage) Eyes without a face
[02:03.53](Les yeux sans visage) Eyes without a face
[02:10.59]Got no human grace
[02:13.03]Your eyes without a face
[02:36.83]When you hear the music you make a dip
[02:39.75]Into someone else's pocket, then make a slip
[02:43.14]Steal a car and go to Las Vegas, ooh
[02:47.02]Gigolo pool, hanging out by the state line
[02:50.89]Turning holy water into wine
[02:54.06]Drinking it down, ooh-ooh, ow
[02:59.79]I'm on a bus on a psychedelic trip
[03:02.16]Reading murder books, trying to stay hip
[03:05.47]I'm thinking of you and you're out there, so
[03:09.19]Say your prayers
[03:11.89]Say your prayers
[03:14.83]Say your prayers
[03:33.34]Now I close my eyes
[03:37.49]And I wonder why
[03:40.70]I don't despise
[03:44.55]Now all I can do
[03:48.76]Love what was once so alive and new
[03:54.55]But it's gone from your eyes, I'd better realize
[04:01.43](Les yeux sans visage) Eyes without a face
[04:06.98](Les yeux sans visage) Eyes without a face
[04:12.62](Les yeux sans visage) Eyes without a face
[04:19.48]Got no human grace
[04:22.17]Your eyes without a face
[04:25.02]Such a human waste
[04:27.73]Your eyes without a face
[04:38.91]And now it's getting worse
